# Rivane / Version 2

Open /rivane/ for this alternate deck. The original deck is at /rivane-classic/.

An 11-slide investor presentation with animated workflow cards, keyboard navigation, Rivane branding, founder photos and product screenshots. The product slide links to the supplied Trupeer video.

Reference decorative paper textures are loaded from the original reference site's assets; Geist is loaded from Google Fonts. Rivane assets are shared from ../assets/.

Content-specific adaptations: discovery evidence instead of unrelated medical time statistics; a group-accounting diagram instead of a clinic photo; opportunity strategy instead of an unsupported market-size estimate; qualitative competitive positioning instead of unsupported numeric rankings; two founder portraits instead of one.

Keyboard: left/right arrows, F fullscreen, O overview, H help. URL hashes select slides. The reference template scales a 1600×900 canvas to the viewport.
